out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. PIC was unable to locate the 2025 permit to operate.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS requested a new copy of the 2025 permit be mailed to facility from the Health Department. Please post this permit in public view as soon as it is received.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM was present at the beginning of inspection, facility PIC has expired certificate.
violations.corrective_action: Ensure a certified food manager is on the premises during all hours of operation. A CFM arrived at the end of inspection.
